Heather.text: Okay, listen, because I'm only saying this once. I'm here to win, and honestly, most of you are just standing in my way.

Owen.text: Oh man, this is gonna be the best summer ever! Did somebody say there's a buffet? Because I am so ready for a buffet.

Gwen.text: Great. A summer camp. Exactly what I wanted. Wake me up when it's over, or when somebody actually says something interesting.
